description: This Java source file defines a Spring component `OpenApiServerCustomizer` that customizes the OpenAPI document generation to dynamically set the server URL based on incoming request headers (`X-Forwarded-*`). It ensures that Swagger UI's 'Try it out' feature uses the correct external URL, which is especially useful for behind reverse proxies or load balancers.

classes.name: OpenApiServerCustomizer
classes.description: A Spring component implementing OpenApiCustomiser to modify the OpenAPI specification dynamically based on request headers for correct server URL configuration.

methods.name: customise
methods.description: Overrides the method to set the server URL in the OpenAPI object based on forwarded request headers.

methods.name: deriveServerUrlFromForwardedHeaders
methods.description: Retrieves request headers `X-Forwarded-Proto`, `X-Forwarded-Host`, and `X-Forwarded-Port` to construct the full external server URL.
